who: Developers and students who let LLM agents read untrusted READMEs and web pages on a machine that also holds secrets such as API keys.
agent_work: The agent reads a poisoned README and web page inside a Celesto microVM, writes notes and a merged summary.md, while a host-side hook audits every shell command.
proof_output: summary.md produced in the guest, plus commands.jsonl showing blocked exfiltration attempts
